blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Nunawading in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the true cost of kitchen renovations in Nunawading. This comprehensive guide covers pricing, materials, and expert advice for Melbourne homeowners.
body: Planning a kitchen renovation in Nunawading is one of the most exciting investments a homeowner can make, but understanding the true costs involved is essential before committing to any project. At Apadana Design, we have been renovating kitchens across Melbourne's eastern suburbs for over 15 years, and we know that every project is unique. The final cost of your Nunawading kitchen renovation depends on a range of factors including the size of your kitchen, the complexity of the design, the quality of materials you select, and whether any structural changes are required. In this comprehensive guide, we will break down the typical costs you can expect and help you plan your budget with confidence.

For Nunawading homeowners considering a kitchen renovation in 2026, costs generally fall into three broad categories depending on the scope and scale of the project. A basic kitchen refresh, which may include painting existing cabinetry, replacing hardware, installing a new splashback, and updating light fittings, typically ranges from $8,000 to $15,000. A mid-range kitchen renovation involving new cabinetry, stone or engineered stone benchtops, quality appliances, new flooring, and updated plumbing and electrical work generally costs between $15,000 and $30,000. For a complete luxury kitchen transformation featuring custom-designed cabinetry, premium natural stone benchtops, high-end integrated appliances, and significant layout changes, you should expect to invest anywhere from $30,000 to $60,000 or more.

Several key factors influence the overall cost of your Nunawading kitchen renovation beyond just the scope of work. The layout of your existing kitchen plays a significant role, as moving plumbing, gas lines, or electrical wiring adds both time and expense to the project. The materials you choose have a substantial impact on your final budget, with premium options like Caesarstone, marble, or solid timber commanding higher prices than laminate or engineered alternatives. Appliance selection is another major cost driver, as high-end brands like Miele, Fisher & Paykel, and SMEG carry premium price tags. The age of your Nunawading home is also relevant, as older properties may require upgrades to meet current building codes, including electrical switchboard improvements or plumbing modifications.

Nunawading's housing stock presents specific considerations for kitchen renovation costs. Many homes in the area were built in the 1970s and 1980s, which means kitchens often feature outdated layouts, old plumbing, and wiring that may not meet current safety standards. Our experience renovating kitchens in Nunawading has shown that approximately 40 percent of projects in older homes require some level of plumbing or electrical upgrades as part of the renovation process. These essential works, while adding to the upfront cost, ensure your new kitchen operates safely and efficiently for decades to come. Engaging a professional kitchen renovation team familiar with Nunawading's property types ensures these underlying issues are properly identified and addressed.

One of the most common questions we receive at our Nunawading studio is whether a kitchen renovation offers good value for money compared to other home improvements. The answer is a resounding yes. According to industry data, a well-executed kitchen renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs can deliver a return on investment of 60 to 80 percent when you sell your home. More importantly, a thoughtfully designed and beautifully renovated kitchen enhances your daily living experience, creating a space where your family gathers, meals are prepared, and memories are made. For Nunawading homeowners, investing in a quality kitchen renovation is one of the smartest decisions you can make.

When planning your Nunawading kitchen renovation budget, we always recommend building in a contingency of 10 to 15 percent to cover unexpected discoveries, particularly in older homes where hidden issues may emerge once demolition begins. At Apadana Design, we provide detailed, fixed-price quotes for every kitchen renovation project, so you know exactly what you are paying for before any work commences. Our design consultants will visit your Nunawading home, assess your existing kitchen, discuss your vision and requirements, and provide a comprehensive proposal that covers every aspect of your renovation. Contact us today to schedule your free consultation and take the first step towards your dream kitchen.

blogPosts.title: Planning a Bathroom Renovation in Melbourne's Eastern Suburbs: The Complete Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Nunawading homeowners need to know about planning a bathroom renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, from design to completion.
body: A bathroom renovation is one of the most impactful improvements you can make to your Melbourne home, and for Nunawading homeowners, it represents both a lifestyle upgrade and a smart financial investment. Melbourne's eastern suburbs, including Nunawading, Doncaster, Blackburn, and Box Hill, feature a diverse range of bathroom styles and conditions, from original mid-century designs to more contemporary spaces that need modernising. At Apadana Design, we have over 15 years of experience planning and executing bathroom renovations across these suburbs, and we understand the unique challenges and opportunities that Melbourne homes present. This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know about planning your bathroom renovation from start to finish.

The first step in any successful Nunawading bathroom renovation is understanding what you want to achieve and establishing a realistic budget. Consider how you currently use your bathroom and what frustrates you about the space. Do you need better storage, improved lighting, a larger shower, or a more functional layout? Melbourne's eastern suburbs experience a temperate climate with cold winters and warm summers, so your bathroom design should account for adequate ventilation to prevent mould and moisture damage, heated flooring for comfort during cooler months, and durable materials that withstand temperature fluctuations. Establishing clear priorities and a well-considered budget early in the planning process will help guide every decision throughout your Nunawading renovation.

Design and layout considerations are critical to the success of your bathroom renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs. Work with an experienced designer who understands the specific requirements of Nunawading homes and Melbourne building regulations. The Victorian Building Authority mandates that all bathroom plumbing and electrical work must be completed by licensed tradespeople, and certain renovations may require council permits. Popular bathroom design trends in Melbourne's eastern suburbs include walk-in showers with frameless glass screens, freestanding bathtubs, wall-hung vanities that create a sense of space, and large-format tiles that minimise grout lines. Maximising natural light through skylights, frosted windows, or well-placed artificial lighting can dramatically improve the feel of a bathroom, particularly in Nunawading homes where bathrooms may have limited natural light.

Budgeting for a bathroom renovation in Nunawading requires careful consideration of several cost components. For a standard bathroom renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, you can expect to invest between $12,000 and $25,000, which covers demolition, waterproofing, tiling, plumbing, electrical work, and fixture installation. Premium bathroom renovations with custom features, luxury fixtures, and bespoke tiling can range from $25,000 to $40,000 or more. Key investment areas that should never be compromised include waterproofing, as poor waterproofing is the most common cause of costly damage in renovated bathrooms, quality tiling and grouting, reliable fixtures from established brands, and proper ventilation systems. Apadana Design provides detailed, fixed-price quotes for every Nunawading bathroom renovation, so you can plan your budget with complete confidence.

The bathroom renovation process in Nunawading typically follows a structured timeline to ensure quality results. Initial design and planning takes two to three weeks, during which we finalise layouts, select materials, and obtain any necessary permits. Demolition and waterproofing require one to two weeks, with waterproofing being a critical stage that must cure properly before tiling can commence. The tiling and fixture installation phase typically takes two to three weeks, depending on the complexity of your tile selections and the number of fixtures being installed. Final finishes, including sealing, painting, and accessory installation, generally require one week. For Nunawading homeowners, the entire bathroom renovation process from initial consultation to completion usually spans six to ten weeks, and our team provides regular updates throughout so you always know what to expect.

Choosing the right bathroom renovation team is crucial to achieving the results you envision for your Nunawading home. Look for a renovation specialist with extensive experience in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, a strong portfolio of completed bathroom projects, and the ability to manage every aspect of your renovation from design through to completion. At Apadana Design, we pride ourselves on our comprehensive approach to bathroom renovations in Nunawading. Our in-house team handles design, project management, plumbing, electrical work, waterproofing, tiling, and all finishing touches, ensuring consistent quality and clear communication throughout your renovation. We invite Nunawading homeowners to visit our showroom, explore our portfolio of completed bathroom renovations, and discuss their project with our experienced design consultants.

blogPosts.title: Best Materials for Kitchen and Bathroom Renovations in Melbourne's Climate
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn which renovation materials perform best in Melbourne's variable climate, from benchtops to tiles to cabinetry for your Nunawading home.
body: Selecting the right materials is one of the most important decisions you will make when planning a kitchen or bathroom renovation in Melbourne's eastern suburbs. Nunawading's climate, characterised by cool, sometimes freezing winters and warm to hot summers, presents specific challenges that directly impact how renovation materials perform over time. At Apadana Design, we have over 15 years of experience renovating kitchens and bathrooms in Nunawading, and we understand which materials withstand Melbourne's variable conditions and which ones fall short. This guide will help you make informed material choices that ensure your renovation looks beautiful and performs flawlessly for many years to come.

Kitchen benchtop materials require careful selection to handle Melbourne's climate and the demands of daily use. For Nunawading kitchens, engineered stone such as Caesarstone or Silestone is an excellent choice, offering exceptional durability, stain resistance, and minimal maintenance requirements. These materials handle Melbourne's temperature variations well and are available in a wide range of colours and patterns to suit any design aesthetic. Natural stone, including granite and marble, provides unmatched beauty but requires more maintenance, including regular sealing to protect against staining. For budget-conscious Nunawading homeowners, high-quality laminate benchtops from brands like Laminex have improved dramatically in recent years, offering attractive designs at a fraction of the cost of stone alternatives. Solid timber benchtops, while beautiful, require more maintenance in Melbourne's variable humidity and should be sealed regularly to prevent warping.

Cabinetry materials and construction methods are equally important for Nunawading kitchen and bathroom renovations. The cabinetry you select must withstand Melbourne's temperature swings without warping, swelling, or deteriorating. Moisture-resistant MDF or marine-grade plywood substrates are recommended for bathroom cabinetry, where humidity levels are consistently higher. For kitchen cabinetry, quality melamine-faced boards or polyurethane-painted surfaces provide excellent durability and are easy to clean, which is essential for busy Nunawading families. The construction method matters as much as the material, with dovetail joints and soft-close hinges signifying quality craftsmanship that will last. At Apadana Design, we source our cabinetry materials from trusted Australian suppliers who understand the demands of Melbourne's climate, ensuring your Nunawading kitchen or bathroom cabinetry performs beautifully for decades.

Tile selection for kitchens and bathrooms in Nunawading requires consideration of both aesthetics and practical performance. Porcelain tiles are the top recommendation for Melbourne's eastern suburbs, as they are incredibly durable, water-resistant, and handle temperature fluctuations without cracking or fading. For bathroom floors, textured porcelain tiles with a slip-resistant rating are essential for safety, particularly in Melbourne's cooler months when wet floors can be hazardous. Large-format tiles have become increasingly popular in Nunawading renovations, creating a contemporary look with fewer grout lines, which reduces maintenance and improves water resistance. Natural stone tiles, including travertine and slate, offer stunning visual appeal but require regular sealing and more maintenance than porcelain alternatives. For kitchen splashbacks, glazed ceramic or glass tiles provide excellent moisture resistance and are available in countless colours and patterns to complement your design scheme.

Waterproofing materials and systems are non-negotiable for any bathroom renovation in Nunawading. Melbourne's building regulations require waterproofing to meet strict Australian standards, and the quality of your waterproofing system will determine the longevity of your entire renovation. We recommend liquid-applied polyurethane or cementitious waterproofing membranes for Nunawading bathrooms, as these products provide superior protection against moisture penetration and handle Melbourne's temperature variations well. For shower recesses, a comprehensive waterproofing system including flood testing before tiling is essential to prevent costly water damage down the track. Apadana Design uses only premium waterproofing systems that comply with Australian Standard AS 3740, ensuring your Nunawading bathroom renovation is protected against moisture damage for the long term.

Flooring materials for kitchens and bathrooms in Melbourne's eastern suburbs should prioritise durability, moisture resistance, and comfort underfoot. Porcelain tiles remain the gold standard for both kitchen and bathroom flooring in Nunawading, offering exceptional durability and water resistance. For homeowners seeking a warmer feel underfoot, luxury vinyl plank flooring has become an increasingly popular choice for Nunawading kitchens, providing excellent water resistance and a comfortable surface that stays warmer than tile during Melbourne's cold winters. Natural timber flooring, while beautiful, is generally not recommended for bathrooms due to moisture concerns, though engineered timber with appropriate sealing can work well in kitchen areas. At our Nunawading showroom, we can help you explore flooring options that balance aesthetics, performance, and budget for your Melbourne renovation project.

Hardware, fixtures, and fittings are the finishing touches that bring your Nunawading renovation together and should be selected with the same care as larger material choices. For kitchen and bathroom renovations in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, invest in quality brass or stainless steel fixtures that resist corrosion and maintain their appearance over time. Brushed nickel and matte black finishes have become popular choices in Nunawading homes, offering a contemporary look that pairs well with modern design schemes. Soft-close drawer runners and hinges are standard in quality renovations, preventing slamming and extending the life of your cabinetry. Apadana Design partners with leading Australian fixture brands to ensure every element of your Nunawading renovation meets the highest standards of quality and performance.

blogPosts.title: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Nunawading? Realistic Timelines
blogPosts.excerpt: Understand the realistic timeline for a kitchen renovation in Nunawading, from planning and demolition through to the final finishes.
body: One of the most frequent questions we hear from Nunawading homeowners considering a kitchen renovation is how long the process will take from start to finish. At Apadana Design, we have been managing kitchen renovations across Melbourne's eastern suburbs for over 15 years, and we understand that timing is a critical factor in planning your project. The honest answer is that every kitchen renovation is different, and the timeline depends on the scope of work, the complexity of the design, material availability, and the size of your existing kitchen. However, based on our extensive experience completing kitchen renovations in Nunawading and surrounding suburbs, we can provide you with realistic timeframes to help you plan your project effectively and minimise disruption to your daily routine.

The planning and design phase is the foundation of your Nunawading kitchen renovation and typically takes two to four weeks. During this stage, our design consultants visit your home to take precise measurements, discuss your vision, requirements, and budget, and develop detailed plans and 3D renders of your new kitchen. This is also when material selections are finalised, including cabinetry styles, benchtop materials, splashback designs, flooring options, and appliance choices. For Nunawading homeowners, the planning phase is an investment that pays dividends throughout the rest of your renovation, as clear, detailed plans reduce the risk of costly changes and delays during construction. At Apadana Design, we work closely with our Nunawading clients during this phase to ensure every detail is considered before any work commences.

Demolition and preparation is the first physical stage of your Nunawading kitchen renovation and usually takes three to seven days depending on the extent of the existing kitchen. This phase involves removing old cabinetry, benchtops, splashbacks, flooring, and any appliances that are being replaced. In older Nunawading homes, demolition may reveal hidden issues such as outdated plumbing, asbestos-containing materials, or structural concerns that need to be addressed before new work can begin. Our team at Apadana Design always includes a contingency allowance in our project timelines to account for these potential discoveries, particularly in Nunawading's older housing stock. Once demolition is complete, any necessary repairs, upgrades, or structural modifications are completed before the exciting construction phase begins.

The construction phase is where your new Nunawading kitchen truly takes shape and typically spans four to seven weeks for a standard renovation. This phase follows a carefully coordinated sequence of trades, beginning with rough-in work for plumbing, gas, and electrical services. Once the rough-in is complete, installation of new cabinetry commences, followed by benchtop fabrication and fitting, which usually requires templating after cabinets are installed. Tiling of splashbacks and flooring, painting, and the installation of appliances and fixtures complete the construction phase. For Nunawading kitchen renovations involving significant layout changes or structural modifications, this phase may extend to eight to ten weeks. Apadana Design manages every trade and coordinates all deliveries to ensure your Nunawading renovation progresses smoothly and on schedule.

Finishing and handover is the final stage of your Nunawading kitchen renovation, typically taking one to two weeks. This phase includes the installation of final fixtures such as tapware, handles, lighting, and power points, followed by a thorough clean and detailed inspection of every element of your new kitchen. At Apadana Design, we conduct a comprehensive walkthrough with every Nunawading client to ensure every detail meets our exacting standards and your expectations. We address any touch-ups or adjustments required, provide you with care and maintenance instructions for your new materials and finishes, and supply all relevant warranties and compliance documentation. For Nunawading homeowners, the total timeline from initial consultation to completed kitchen renovation typically ranges from eight to fourteen weeks, depending on the scope and complexity of the project.

Several factors specific to Nunawading and Melbourne's eastern suburbs can influence your kitchen renovation timeline. Seasonal demand plays a role, as kitchen renovations are particularly popular during spring and autumn, which can affect trade availability and lead times for materials. Supply chain considerations for imported appliances and specialty materials should be factored into your planning, as delivery times can vary. Weather conditions in Melbourne, particularly during winter, can occasionally impact scheduling for any exterior work or material deliveries. At Apadana Design, we maintain strong relationships with local suppliers and trades throughout Melbourne's eastern suburbs, allowing us to manage your Nunawading kitchen renovation efficiently and keep your project on track.

We understand that living without a functioning kitchen is one of the biggest concerns for Nunawading homeowners considering a renovation. At Apadana Design, we work with every client to minimise disruption, including setting up temporary kitchen arrangements and coordinating trades to ensure the most efficient workflow possible. Our project management approach means you have a single point of contact throughout your Nunawading renovation, providing regular updates and clear communication so you always know what to expect. If you are planning a kitchen renovation in Nunawading and want to understand the specific timeline for your project, contact us today for a free consultation. Our experienced team will assess your kitchen, discuss your requirements, and provide a detailed project schedule tailored to your Nunawading home.
